## Before activation
1. Apply 20260927_email_notifications.sql, then 20260927_work_order_status_notifications.sql.
2. Select the Supabase Postgres credential in both SQL nodes.
3. Enable Gmail API and create Gmail OAuth2 credential for contact@flowrisedental.ro. Select it in Send with Gmail.
4. Configure app@flowrisedental.ro in Gmail Send mail as.
5. Enable preferences for a test user; create a test order or change its overall status and run manually.
6. Select Header Auth in Notification webhook (X-Flowrise-Webhook-Secret).
7. Activate and configure a Supabase Database Webhook: INSERT only on public.email_notification_queue, POST to https://app.flowrisedental.ro/api/ai/flowrise-email-notifications with the same secret header.
8. Disable the previous minute-based workflow. See docs/email-notifications.md for testing.

Immediate webhook plus hourly recovery. Batches of 10, at most 20 batches per execution. Empty claim stops processing. Remaining backlog waits for another webhook or hourly run. Only HTTP 429 is retried (max 5 attempts). 5xx/timeouts become uncertain; check Sent mail before replay. Inspect failed/uncertain states in Supabase. Never retry a whole send execution blindly. No patient data in email.
